name: AxialNest for Woocommerce
author: luisboto

sections.description:
AxialNest is the 3D customizer platform that allows your customers to customize your products to their liking using 3D and AR technology, creating completely unique orders tailored to their needs. Once you’ve got your AxialNest account up and running, this plugin allows your product pages to display the 3D customizer, integrate the dynamic pricing features, and display the customization configurations on your admin orders page.

Requirements

AxialNest is a 3rd party service that allows configuring your own 3D products from the AxialNest admin panel.
Please note you need an AxialNest account to make use of this plugin and to propertly display the 3D customizer on your website. This plugin collects no information other than the minimum required by functional requirements.
Please check AxialNest’s privacy policy. to learn more on the information we collect.

Features

  • Display an AxialNest product with the 3D/AR customizer on any product page.
  • Show dynamic pricing on any customization.
  • Display the 3D viewer on non-customizable products.
  • Select product materials, parts, camera movements and more.
  • Allow customers to upload their own logos, pictures or text to customize their orders.
  • Easily check customized orders on the administrator orders page.

Premium plans

For a full experience, check the premium plans on the AxialNest website. Please note this plugin merely allows integrating your products on AxialNest with Woocommerce.

screenshots.caption: AxialNest allows your customers to view and customize 3D products.
The AxialNest admin panel allows you to easily configure all your needs for your customizer experience.
Have control over the looks of every texture.
Change the extension settings to make it a perfect fit on your store.
Toggable customization on every woo product page.
